text:
Maya K.: Quick sync 1 for the virtual launch lab next Wed. Need final signoff on reg page copy, GDPR consent line for EU, Zoom recording config (cloud + local fallback), SRT captions + auto-translate, HubSpot fields + lifecycle mapping, and post-event deliverables/timeline. Who takes what?
Owen T.: I ll take reg page copy and QA the form. Planning to add a brief consent: "We ll use your info to send event materials. You can opt out anytime." Will localize to FR/DE/ES on the thank-you page. ETA: EOD today.
Priya S.: HubSpot mapping: suggest hidden fields: utm_source, benchmark_cohort, region, consent_given. On import set lifecycle = "marketing_qualified" for registrants with consent, otherwise keep as "subscriber". Also confirm timezone field to route reminders regionally.
Samira N.: Zoom setup recommendations: host = Maya, co-host = Owen; cloud recording + local recording to host machine as fallback. Enable SRT captions and auto-translate to English + Spanish. Enable chat export. Waiting room ON until -3min. Also set alternative stream URL in case cloud record fails.
Maya K.: Alternative stream? Can you paste the RTMP fallback and the S3 ingest prefix so editors can find clips quickly? Also need naming convention for clips + transcripts.
Samira N.: RTMP fallback snippet for Ops (copy to runbook):
```
# RTMP fallback if cloud recording fails
rtmp://streams.redwood.example/live/virtual-lab_2026-05-12_fallback
# S3 ingest watches prefix: /events/virtual-lab/2026-05-12/recordings/
```
Suggested clip naming: virtual-lab_2026-05-12__{speaker_short}__{segment}_v{rev}.mp4 and transcript as .vtt with same base name. Example: virtual-lab_2026-05-12__Maya__intro_v1.mp4
Owen T.: I'll add hidden timezone selector and ensure reminder flows fire at local 1 hour and 15 minutes. Also embedding small calendar invite link on the thank-you page.
Priya S.: For HubSpot import: CSV headers: email, first_name, last_name, utm_source, benchmark_cohort, region, consent_given, timezone. Import job will tag source = "virtual_lab_may2026" and set lifecycle accordingly. Post-import job will kick off enrichment and SDR assignment if benchmark_cohort == "enterprise".
Maya K.: Post-event timeline: raw recordings + initial auto-transcript in 36h, 48h highlight pack (3 clips, ~2 mins each), edited full recording + timestamps in 7 days. SDR outreach to start 48-72h after highlight pack upload. Who owns each?
Owen T.: I ll own clip exports and the highlight pack (48h). Will upload to s3://redwood-events/virtual-lab/2026-05-12/ and populate the clip sheet with metadata including benchmark_cohort, timestamp offsets, and recommended social snippets.
Priya S.: I ll handle import, enrichment, and SDR assignments once Owen tags the clip sheet. I ll set lifecycle stage to "sales_contact" when a registrant has >50% watch time or clicks demo CTA.
Samira N.: Ops note: run an RTMP route test tomorrow 9am PT and a caption quality test at 10am PT. I ll add a small webhook healthcheck for Zoom cloud recordings:
```
POST /zoom/webhook/recording_status
headers: X-Zoom-Signature: <sig>
body: {"event":"recording.completed","meeting_id":"{id}","url":"{cloud_url}"}
```
If the webhook returns 5xx, fallback to RTMP routing.
webinar-bot: Reminder: "Virtual Launch Lab" scheduled 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z. Cloud recording & SRT captions enabled.
Maya K.: OK final checklist: Owen confirm S3 path after a test upload, Samira confirm RTMP test tomorrow and webhook monitoring, Priya confirm HubSpot import job & expected lifecycle transitions. If all green I ll publish the Notion runbook and pin to channel. :rocket:
Owen T.: Test upload scheduled after 11am PT tomorrow, will confirm path and post the sample file in #marketing.
Samira N.: RTMP + caption tests on calendar, will ping infra and add runbook snippet.
Priya S.: HubSpot import job scheduled 24h after recording upload; will share import checklist in the runbook.
Maya K.: Thanks team 1 closing thread 1 I ll post the final runbook and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
